about: Verification rows chosen by the DFlash2 drafter's confidence (spec_rows_choose). Platt scaling per depth 0, 1, 2, >= 3, calibrated on 16 prompts (6,425 anchors; simulated without recalibrating: +7.9 % with another drafter). Cost: ms per round with k = 2..8 rows per tokens in the cache, measured with a microbenchmark of the verification rows (masked, rows 8,7,6,5,4,3,2) on this model on an M6, with isotonic regression.
